newsitem.title: USA: APS Holding Corp sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: APS Holding Corp sees Q4 loss.

text.p: APS Holding Corp said Tuesday it expects to report a loss from operations, prior to certain charges, in this year's fourth quarter ending January 25.
APS cited continued softness in the automotive aftermarket, earnings pressure from the Installers' Service Warehouse division and higher interest costs for the expected loss.
APS said the fourth quarter financial results also will reflect certain pretax charges of about $20 million.

The charges related to the write-down of certain current assets in the company's ISW division, an increase in the bad debt provision for ISW and a charge for the cost of returning excess and slow-moving inventories both at ISW and in the company's distribution centers, the company said.
The company reported operating income of $1.1 million, or $0.08 a share, for the same period last year.
APS also said it does not expect to match analysts' of $1.75 to $2.00 a share for the fiscal year ending Jan. 31, 1998.
APS distributes branded automotive replacement parts, as well as tools, equipment, supplies and accessories.
